items.html: And afterward the light of Yesod came out, and the light of Hesed was in its place, as was said above, and then the vessel of Hochma had to extend by way of the right line, until the place fit to be the true Hesed after the correction, and then the light of Hesed rose there and was included in the whole of Hochma, and the vessel of Hesed descended to Tifferet of Beria, and then Yesod came out and entered its vessel and reigned in its place and broke, and the light rose by way of the middle line, and rose to the place of the upper Daat, and its vessel descended into Gevura of Beria. And afterward we shall explain why the light of Yesod rose above Tifferet, up to Daat.
